sect1.title: Version X.Y.0 (date TBD)
sect1.para: This is a major update. The following new features were added:

listitem.para: GUI: Added token-aware Material 3 buttons for the manager title bar, including keyboard activation, accessible names, focus states and a 48-pixel minimum interaction target
GUI: Added a Ctrl+Shift+F command palette that searches live manager actions, supports optional regular expressions, and returns focus after Escape or command activation
GUI: Stabilized command-palette owner cleanup with bounded command registrations, localized category labels, accessible result descriptions, and handler validation
GUI: Wired the independent English and Hong Kong Cantonese funny levels into registered Material 3 copy, with immediate persistence and live language-change notifications
GUI: Bundled the Material 3 manager destination icons in a shared Qt resource and mapped them to the existing model-backed navigation rail with a deterministic standard-icon fallback
GUI: Extended the per-element Material 3 editor with a live preview and an anchored regular-expression search over its properties
GUI: Added an embedded Material 3 wizard shell with translated page titles, step progress, completion state, and the existing validation, notification, and button contracts preserved

GUI: Added bounded persistent Material 3 notification history for non-blocking messages, with local plain-text/regular-expression search, unread tracking, atomic application-data storage, and legacy blocking question/progress paths preserved
GUI: Added a manager-header Notifications action that opens the modeless history surface and exposes an unread-state marker without changing blocking notification behavior
GUI: Added filtered notification-history selection, inversion, selected-read updates, and bounded atomic JSON export while retaining the existing blocking-operation rules

GUI: Added an app-owned Clear history confirmation that states the exact record count, requires two acknowledgements and a full-range slider, animates authorization progress, and provides Emergency exit, Escape cancellation, and focus return before clearing records

GUI: Added a bounded one-step Undo last clear recovery snapshot beneath the application-data directory, with schema validation and atomic restore without changing the legacy blocking notification paths

GUI: Added a shared append-only local history journal with bounded JSONL records, SHA-256 state validation, best-effort isolated Git commits, and notification clear/restore/change revisions with an atomic-file fallback

GUI: Added the modeless local-history browser on Ctrl+H and in the command palette, with plain-text-first search and anchored regular expression support, action and date filters, bounded JSONL export, and inline integrity verification; the Network Manager shortcut is now Ctrl+Shift+H

GUI: Added a validated Restore notification state action to the local-history browser; notification revisions are applied only by the owning bounded schema and every restore is appended as a new history revision

GUI: Added owner-routed restoration for validated Material 3 appearance and theme revisions, including bounded palette, density, typography, named-theme, and per-element state; each restoration is appended to the local history journal
GUI: Added live persisted Material font-family previews and a global font-weight selector with an Inherited role-weight option in Global Preferences
GUI: Added the tab strip's Move into group picker with bounded search, member counts, a top-level target, and inline group creation
GUI: Added searchable strip actions for creating and renaming tab groups and opening a per-group Material 3 appearance editor with bounded, accessible group-name input
GUI: Replaced decorative tab overflow text with a focusable Material 3 More-tabs button that opens the searchable overflow list

Building the OSE Edition: Implemented a new configure.py script which unifies the ./configure (non-Windows) and configure.vbs (Windows) scripts Please adjust your building process accordingly, as the compatibility wrapper scripts ./configure and configure.vbs are now marked as being deprecated and will be removed in a future version of VirtualBox.

sect1.para: In addition, the following items were fixed or added:

listitem.para: NAT: Fixed ICMP traceroute missing intermediate hops when using NAT networking
VBoxManage: Added natnetwork log and dhcpserver log commands to display NAT network and DHCP server log files

VBoxManage: Added new 'clipboard' sub command for controlling the Shared Clipboard along with other new features such as listening for clipboard events or copying / pasting clipboard data. Verbose clipboard event output reports non-UTF-8/UTF-16 payloads as binary data with their size. The 'modifyvm' clipboard options are now marked as being deprecated.

Shared Clipboard: Fixed plain-text copy and paste on macOS hosts and improved VBoxManage clipboard listen event and payload output, including compact logfmt-style human records and a startup warning when Shared Clipboard is disabled
